Constraints: avoid duplicate emails; max 3 retries with jitter; queue=billing-critical. Please produce a phased rollout plan with explicit acceptance checks and a rollback plan. args.notes: Deadline: today. Must respect constraints: no duplicate emails; max 3 retries with jitter. Deliver phased rollout with acceptance checklists + rollback.

args.input_text: Learning for billing-workers PDF retry work: Always design retries with idempotency and side-effect suppression. Use a deterministic idempotency key (e.g., invoice_id + document_version) for PDF generation and a separate key for email send; store a send ledger so email is emitted once even if the job retries. Cap retries at 3 with jitter; ensure Sidekiq retry strategy doesn’t exceed cap. Add metrics/alerts for retry storms and duplicate suppression events; document rollback steps and feature-flag rollout if changing behavior in billing-critical.
